raceLabel: 2026 Grand Prix at Road America Race 2

sourceRefs.note: Bryce's per-lap section times, speeds, and field percentiles from official Section Results reports.
Full-field per-section time distributions and Bryce's per-lap derived remainder (lap time minus timed sections) with real full-field percentiles.
Every car's per-lap section times and clean flags; the other cars' clean times ship as otherCarLaps, anonymous, so each scope compares him with the rest of the field over the same laps.

caveats: Section times come from official timing loops — time-based, not GPS or car position.
Field percentile compares source-visible cars on the same lap; clean flags follow the lap-chart caution context.
The untimed remainder is lap time minus the timed sections — the exact time on stretches with no loops, ranked against the field the same way.
fieldSeconds is every timed car's whole-race median, Bryce included (the source distribution). otherCarLaps leaves him out: the comparisons on screen read the other cars only.
Aggregates should use clean green-flag laps and label their denominators on screen.
